title: Idgham and ikhfa in Ya-Sin 5 to 8: rule card and examples
subject: Qur'an & Tajweed
source: Written for quran/y10 lesson 14 (Pupil PDF worksheet: Idgham and ikhfa in Ya-Sin 5 to 8 rule card and examples)
intro: Lesson 14. Read the rule and say every example aloud. Point to each word in your mushaf. Then answer the questions.

panels.title: Ikhfa takes the colour of the next letter
points: Before ذ: light, tongue ready to peep out
Before ق ك ص ط: heavier hum

panels.title: Idgham with ghunnah: tanween into م
points: The tanween vanishes into the meem
Two-count ghunnah on the merged meem

keywords.def: reciting each letter with its right and its rules

questions.q: Read 36:6 «لِتُنذِرَ قَوْمًۭا مَّآ أُنذِرَ ءَابَآؤُهُمْ فَهُمْ غَٰفِلُونَ» naming each rule.
questions.a: لِتُنذِرَ ikhfa; قَوْمًۭا مَّآ idgham; مَّآ أُنذِرَ munfasil and ikhfa; ءَابَآؤُهُمْ muttasil; فَهُمْ غَٰفِلُونَ izhar shafawi.

questions.q: Breakout pairs: recite Juz' 'Amma block 2 (81 to 85) to a partner, then 36:1 to 8. Today's rota group recites 36:5 to 8 to the teacher.
questions.a: Partner rubric and target; teacher records rota scores.

questions.q: Extend: find an iqlab in Ya-Sin 36:9.
Stretch: explain why ikhfa before ق sounds heavier than before ذ.
questions.a: The ghunnah takes the heaviness of the following isti'la letter.
A) Ikhfa. Tanween before ف: ikhfa.

questions.q: Think again: Ya-Sin 36:6 has three ikhfa before the same letter. Which letter, and why might it be easy to get wrong?
questions.a: ذ: the tongue peeps out, so the ikhfa hum must prepare for it without pressing a noon.
